assertions.subject: Primary psychotic disorder
assertions.quote: Primary psychotic disorder is generally synonymous with auditory hallucinations

assertions.subject: Psychosis associated with medical/neurologic conditions
assertions.quote: psychosis associated with medical/neurologic conditions is usually associated with all other types of hallucinations except auditory (e.g., visual, tactile, olfactory)
